dct_title_s: Storm Drain Sub-Basin Boundaries - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains the boundaries of the storm water sub-basins for the city of Newton. These sub-basins are roughly equivalent to watersheds. Related line and point drainage basin coverages may be found in the Storm Water Collection System Lines and Storm Water Collection System Points data layers.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers and planners for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer may provide a basemap for layers related to urban planning, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.
Supplemental information: This data layer is not maintained, as the basin boundaries are very unlikely to change.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational or non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
